headline: Grumpy Walrus at 9:35-9:57 AM ET sold 5M Guinea Pig (~301 ADA), ~3.94M BLUE BULL (~176 ADA) and ~94.6k PERP COIN (~15 ADA), then recycled ~927k MEPE into ~1,299 NIGHT, ~126.6 ASCEND and ~185 ADA cash; net ADA ~+666. ASCEND side slipped to ~986k (~31.5% above the 750k line) on the whale's MEPE→ASCEND clip; stays Watch. ZELDA is a new swarm launch (4 coordinated wallets in 120s, repeat early buyer, first-block sniper already out); no DEX pool; Pass. Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: Grumpy Walrus funded an ASCEND clip by recycling MEPE rather than spending fresh ADA, so an ASCEND add can show up as a token-for-token swap with almost no ADA leg.
